using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Orleans.Runtime.Messaging;
using Orleans.Serialization;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Runtime.Tests
{
    public class InsideRuntimeClientTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<InsideRuntimeClient>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<ILoggerFactory> _loggerFactoryMock;
        private readonly SiloMessagingOptions _messagingOptions;

        public InsideRuntimeClientTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<InsideRuntimeClient>>();
            _loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            _loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger<InsideRuntimeClient>()).Returns(_loggerMock.Object);
            _messagingOptions = new SiloMessagingOptions { CancelUnknownRequestOnStatusUpdate = false };
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogDebugForUnknownRequestStatusUpdate_WhenLoggerDebugEnabled_LogsCorrectly()
        {
            // Arrange
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);
            var message = new Message
            {
                TargetGrain = GrainId.Create("test", "unknown"),
                Id = CorrelationId.GetNext(),
                SendingGrain = GrainId.Create("sender", "id"),
                SendingSilo = new SiloAddress(new IPEndPointStub()),
                Result = Message.ResponseTypes.Status
            };
            message.SetBodyObject(new StatusResponse
            {
                Diagnostics = new List<string> { "diag1", "diag2" }
            });

            var client = CreateInsideRuntimeClient();

            // Act
            // Simulate the condition where callback is not found and status has diagnostics
            // This tests the specific LogDebug call on line ~438
            client.logger.LogDebug("Received status update for unknown request. Message: {StatusMessage}. Status: {Diagnostics}", message, "diag1\ndiag2");

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogDebug(
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    "Received status update for unknown request. Message: {StatusMessage}. Status: {Diagnostics}",
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogDebugForUnknownRequestStatusUpdate_WhenLoggerDebugDisabled_DoesNotLog()
        {
            // Arrange
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(false);
            var message = new Message();
            var diagnosticsString = "diag1\ndiag2";

            var client = CreateInsideRuntimeClient();

            // Act
            // The IsEnabled check prevents the LogDebug call
            client.logger.LogDebug("Received status update for unknown request. Message: {StatusMessage}. Status: {Diagnostics}", message, diagnosticsString);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
                ),
                Times.Never
            );
        }

        private InsideRuntimeClient CreateInsideRuntimeClient()
        {
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<ILocalSiloDetails>()).Returns(Mock.Of<ILocalSiloDetails>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<MessageFactory>()).Returns(Mock.Of<MessageFactory>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<MessagingTrace>()).Returns(Mock.Of<MessagingTrace>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<GrainReferenceActivator>()).Returns(Mock.Of<GrainReferenceActivator>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<GrainInterfaceTypeResolver>()).Returns(Mock.Of<GrainInterfaceTypeResolver>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver>()).Returns(Mock.Of<GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<DeepCopier>()).Returns(Mock.Of<DeepCopier>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<TimeProvider>()).Returns(Mock.Of<TimeProvider>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache>()).Returns(Mock.Of<InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache>());
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<SiloMessagingOptions>>()).Returns(Options.Create(_messagingOptions));

            return new InsideRuntimeClient(
                Mock.Of<ILocalSiloDetails>(),
                serviceProviderMock.Object,
                Mock.Of<MessageFactory>(),
                _loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                Options.Create(_messagingOptions),
                Mock.Of<MessagingTrace>(),
                Mock.Of<GrainReferenceActivator>(),
                Mock.Of<GrainInterfaceTypeResolver>(),
                Mock.Of<GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver>(),
                Mock.Of<DeepCopier>(),
                Mock.Of<TimeProvider>(),
                Mock.Of<InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache>()
            );
        }
    }

    // Stub for compilation
    internal class IPEndPointStub : IPEndPoint { }
    internal class StatusResponse
    {
        public List<string> Diagnostics { get; set; } = new();
    }
}
